entities.name: Go-Shintai of Lost Wisdom
entities.description: Legendary shrine housing a Kami of Lost Wisdom.

entities.name: Kami of Lost Wisdom
entities.description: Kami residing in the shrine, teasing travelers with impossible riddles.

entities.name: Minamo Academy professor
entities.description: Ambitious professor who built the shrine and learned how she would die.

events.summary: An ambitious Minamo professor builds a little shrine that intrigues a Kami of Lost Wisdom.
events.quote: The little shrine she built intrigued a Kami of Lost Wisdom.

events.summary: The kami tells the professor when and how she will die; offended, she asks for the knowledge removed and the kami obliges.
events.quote: The kami obliged, but it still resides in the shrine to this day

relations.note: The kami resides in the shrine.
relations.quote: it still resides in the shrine to this day
